Name: CinderboxExport
Author: AtlasV1224
Description:
[b][size=5]Cinderbox Export[/size][/b]
This mod is for Cinderbox specifically. Content Patcher's `patch export` command, by default, puts any export into a root-only readable folder, this mod patches Content Patcher so that it put the export in `<mods folder>/CinderboxExport/patch export/` instead, which should be a readable folder without root.

[size=4]Usage[/size]
- Drop the mod into your mods folder
- Run `patch export` like usual
- Check `<mods folder>/CinderboxExport/patch export/` instead of `Stardew Valley/patch export/`

This mod hasn't been tested extensively, due to me not having set up Cinderbox, however it has had some testing by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Abagaianye]Abagaianye[/url], so credits and thanks to them!

[size=4]Bugs[/size]
Bugs should be put in the "Bugs" tab, or I am happy to be pinged in discord in the Official Stardew Valley server or the Cinderbox server (atlasv1224)


[url=https://git.atlasv.info/Stardew-Valley-Mods/CinderboxExport]Source[/url]
